property_summary: Calls to deposit revert iff the sent value is zero (i.e., deposit succeeds only for value > 0).
If deposit(...) reverts then the sent value must be zero (i.e., nonzero-value deposits never revert).

If a deposit call reverts then the contract's balance must remain zero (i.e., reverts only occur when sending 0 ether to an empty contract), which holds for P but is violated by M that can overflow and allow reverts with nonzero sent value.

Calling deposit with any value never causes a revert due to integer overflow (i.e., for all addr and value, deposit(value) does not revert when balances[msg.sender] + value does not overflow uint256).
